}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== ===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3576 [[ARM]] ([[big.LITTLE]]) :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A72) @2.2GHz + :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A53) @1.8GHz :• NPU: 6 TOPS @INT8 (2 NPU core) :• GPU: ''Mali-G52 MC3'' (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.0); :• VPU (with 8K @30fps VP9 and H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 64GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash, :TF Card (max. 256GB)/MMC Card slot *Memory: 8GB (LPDDR4x) RAM ([[Rayson]]) *USB: 1x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0, :1x USB (Type-C) 3.0 (DP1.4/OTG) ports *mPCIe: 1x M.2 2280 (Key M) slot for :1x NVMe SSD (PCIe 2.1 1-lane) *Wi-Fi: [[Broadcom]] BCM43752 (SDIO 3.0) :802.11ac/ax (2T2R), Bluetooth 5.0 (BLE) *Network: 2x GbE ports *GPIO: 1x 40-pin connector *Power Source: USB (Type-C) PD 2.0, :9V/2A, 12V/2A, 15V/2A
